name: State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes
benefit: - Each selected awardee receives a Cash Award of ₹5,000/-. - Each selected awardee receives a citation.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an Anganwadi Worker under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes. - The applicant must demonstrate exemplary performance in improving the coverage and quality of services provided to children and pregnant and lactating mothers under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme. - The applicant must show contribution towards the implementation of programmes or schemes of the central Government, state Government, or local bodies.
